name: schematic
summary: Saves a schematic of a build the bot can see (generic block roles: 'solid, light-blocking, non-flammable' instead of cobblestone; exact blocks only where they matter: water levels, hoppers, slabs, trapdoors) and diffs a build against one, cell by cell. bot._schematic.capture / diff / list. brain/inspect uses the room's schematic for its exact check.
